definition: חֹ֫מֶץ noun masculine vinegar — ׳ ח absolute Prov 10:26 + 3 t.; construct Num 6:3 (twice in verse); — a common condiment Ruth 2:14 , forbidden to Nazirite ( יין ׳ ח and שֵׁכָר ׳ ח ) Num 6:3 (twice in verse) ( P ), offered (in cruelty) to a thirsty man Ps 69:22 (figurative for harshness lack of sympathy); in simile of sluggard כַּחֹמֶץ לַשִּׁנַּיִם Prov 10:26 , עַלנָֿ֑תֶר ׳ ח Prov 25:20 vinegar on nitre (simile of merry songs for the heavy-hearted).
